metadata.dataset_name: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) Jaipur Monitoring Well Network

alert_thresholds.Emergency: Sudden GWL drop > 4.5m/quarter in Critical tier
alert_thresholds.Warning: Continuous drawdown with zero monsoon recharge

climatic_vs_anthropogenic_summary.key_finding: Agricultural and tubewell over-pumping accounts for ~58% of localized groundwater depletion in Jaipur Blocks (e.g., Sambher, Jhotwara, Chaksu), exacerbated by seasonal monsoon deficits.
